blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang complex will be under lockdown on Sept. 21, Monday, due to the anticipated massive protests to be conducted by different groups for the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law. The Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said on Sunday the New Executive Building (NEB), which houses a number of Malacañang offices, will be closed on Monday “due to standard security protocols.” The Presidential Action Center in a separate advisory also said its operations on Monday would be suspended “to ensure public safety.” PACe serves as the frontline channel between the Office of the President and the Filipino people, […]...
